note: flat frames (batch flat): PNG pixels are drawn as seen on screen and already stretched 1.2 in y; pivot/anchors in PNG px from the top-left; anchorsWu in world units from the pivot (x right, y up). Dab is a puppet in the cast atlas (public/assets/chars/dab.json), see dab.

pen-red.pivot: the middle of the capped pen

asleep.note: capped, eyes closed; put the string world-zzz above it

awake.note: cap off (posted on the back end, anchor capOff), nib out, tip inked; the scribble sprite draws on beside the status line while the AI thinks; select: lift the sprite 2 px

swap.note: awake -> asleep: cap hops on (0.35 s, arc 0.3 u from capOff to capOn, frame asleep once it lands); asleep -> awake: swap.0 (yawn) 0.25 s, swap.1 0.25 s while the cap hops off to capOff, then awake

no.note: illegal: rotate the sprite +-4 degrees twice in 0.4 s (frame no.0 while shaking)

rattle.note: check: the CAP rattles (jiggle the cap sprite +-0.03 u at 20 Hz for 0.5 s); barrel frame rattle

lie-x.note: resign: cap on, x eyes; rotate the sprite 20 degrees (on its back)

cap.note: separate sprite; pivot = the middle of the cap; positions: anchors.capOn / anchors.capOff of any barrel frame (world units from the barrel pivot)

scribble.note: draw-on spiral (time map); place at anchors.scribbleAt; wipe after the AI has moved

pen-blue.pivot: the middle of the capped pen

no.note: illegal: rotate the sprite +-4 degrees twice in 0.4 s (frame no.0 while shaking)

rattle.note: check: the CAP rattles (jiggle the cap sprite +-0.03 u at 20 Hz for 0.5 s); barrel frame rattle

pressed.note: swing the rest sprite once round its centre in 0.35 s leaving this dashed ring (draw-on)

disabled.note: nothing to undo; a press shakes it +-3 degrees for 1 s

off.note: the x is scribbled over the arcs (draw-on); draw the on frame WITHOUT the arcs is not needed: the x lies on the right of the cone

pop.note: shown for 0.2 s when the sound comes back on

filled.note: scribbled solid; draw-on 0.3 s when a level is chosen

btn-level.note: five sprites, spacing 0.26 u (one row): stars 1..level use filled, the rest outline

dab.signNote: rest position of the sign card in Dab's card space [u0, v0, u1, v1] (the hit box of btn-new = this grown by 0.1; follow the sign prop's dx/dy/rot/sx/sy at run time; layout.json ui[btn-new].box [-0.5,0.05,0.5,0.65] is the placeholder it replaces)
dab.fx: shared fx rig: zzz (sleep), alarm (gasp), sweat (worried), star/sparkle (cheer); strings: oops ouch hmm nice zzz world-dab-psst dab-saw-that
